sloka: कन्यया च पितुर् गेहे वन वासः श्रुतः मयाभिक्षिण्याः साधु वृत्ताया मम मातुर् इह अग्रतः ॥२-२९-१३॥
transliteration: kanyayā ca pitur gehe vana vāsaḥ śrutaḥ mayābhikṣiṇyāḥ sādhu vṛttāyā mama mātur iha agrataḥ ॥2-29-13॥

translations.english: When I was young in my father's house, a holy female mendicant foretold in the presence of my mother that I would dwell in the forest (in this life).
